outputIntent: Translate one abstract idea into one unforgettable physical carrier whose internal transformation has a single readable direction.
positioning: Not generic fantasy scenery or an effects demo; it is a precise visual metaphor with one-to-one semantic mapping and usable overlay space.
contentSchema: one hook transition or echo function

layoutFamilies.topology: sole carrier occupies the right-center; a physically integrated cutaway reveals one internal process; left field remains low complexity
layoutFamilies.readingPath: carrier silhouette -> internal process -> transformed output
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: cinematic close object portrait with macro internal detail and deep negative-space falloff
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one carrier, one internal world, one transformation path, one output cue

layoutFamilies.topology: input fragments enter one carrier along a single arc and exit as one resolved form; no secondary metaphor competes
layoutFamilies.cameraAndScale: wide studio composition with one focal object and controlled directional motion
layoutFamilies.moduleCount: one input family, one carrier, one transformation, one resolved output

physicalVisualSystem.material: physically credible glass, paper, ceramic, metal, liquid, or organic matter chosen to match the carrier; no arbitrary material pileup
physicalVisualSystem.lighting: one cinematic key direction, soft environmental fill, realistic internal refraction or subsurface behavior only when material-appropriate
physicalVisualSystem.color: low-to-moderate saturation with one luminous mood color and neutral surroundings
physicalVisualSystem.typography: no generated text by default; reserve one clean overlay column for deterministic titles

forbiddenElements: pseudo text on paper or screens
qcAssertions: the metaphor can be explained in one sentence
every visible element has a topic-specific meaning
a calm overlay zone and subtitle-safe band remain
